Detour now links to three more creator-owned streaming services, and every platform gets its own subscription switch.

### Added
- **2nd try, WatcherTV and Beacon.** The Try Guys' [2nd try](https://www.2ndtry.tv/), Watcher's [WatcherTV](https://watchertv.com/) and Critical Role's [Beacon](https://beacon.tv/) carry ad-free, uncut or earlier versions of their YouTube videos. Detour links to them from those creators' channel pages and videos. For now these are channel links, so they never redirect.
- **A subscription switch for every platform.** ClockwiseTV, 2nd try, WatcherTV and Beacon each have their own switch in the settings popup, like Nebula's. Platforms you subscribe to are listed first.

### Changed
- **"About" buttons.** On a channel page, a banner for a platform you don't subscribe to now has an "About <platform>" button that opens the platform's homepage. Platforms you subscribe to keep "Open on <platform>".
- **ClockwiseTV** creators now also get a "ClockwiseTV channel" button on their videos, like any channel-only match.
- The store summary, landing page, privacy policy and store listings name every platform.

Detour still sends nothing to Floatplane, ClockwiseTV, 2nd try, WatcherTV or Beacon. Their creators come from Detour's own list.

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
